subject: general
question: Which major agricultural initiative, launched by the Government of India with an outlay of ₹600 crore, aims to enhance long-staple cotton cultivation, promote High-Density Plantation (HDP) methods, and modernize cotton procurement through the Kapas Kisan App?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapas Kranti Mission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India launched the ₹600 crore Kapas Kranti Mission in Hyderabad to boost long-staple cotton cultivation and improve productivity across major cotton-growing states.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The mission promotes High-Density Plantation (HDP) practices, scientific cultivation, and technology-driven procurement models.**
 
• **It aligns with the government’s goal of achieving self-reliance in cotton production and improving income security for farmers.**
 
• **The Kapas Kisan App, launching after Diwali, will help farmers book slots for cotton sales, avoid queues, and ensure fair prices by eliminating middlemen.**
 
• **Telangana farmers will be taken on exposure visits to Maharashtra’s Akola region, which has successfully implemented HDP methods in cotton farming.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Financial Overview**__

 __
 
• Total Outlay – ₹600 crore
 
• Procurement (2014–2024): 473 lakh bales worth ₹1.37 lakh crore
 
• Telangana and Andhra Pradesh procurement value – ₹65,000 crore
 
• MSP for cotton has doubled in the last decade
 
 
 
• **Procurement Infrastructure**__
 __
 
• 122 procurement centres and 345 ginning centres to be opened post-Diwali
 
• Partnerships with Cotton Corporation of India (CCI)
 
• District-level committees established to prevent farmer exploitation
 
 
 
• **High-Density Plantation (HDP)**__
 __
 
• Proven model from Maharashtra’s Akola region
 
• Uses closer plant spacing, improved seeds, and modern agronomy
 
• Enhances yield and resource efficiency
 
 
 
• **Key Leadership**__
 
 
• Mission announced by – Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy
 
• Implemented by – Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
 
• Supports – Atmanirbhar Bharat and farmer income doubling vision
 
 

a7:T18
